notes: ONE PRESS MAKES ONE EPISODE. Creating an episode from a long script takes about a minute (the plan is made from it in the same press) and the file picker used to stay open and silent for that minute, so a second choice made a second episode of the same script. Now the picker closes the moment a file is chosen, the button says 'creating the episode from <file> - making its plan', the page opens the new episode when it is made, a press during that minute is answered instead of queued, and a script an episode already holds - word for word - opens that episode instead of making another. The Episodes board no longer reads 'not installed' for an episode built before an update that added a tool: it says the next run installs it and carries on.
